strings.name: Everybody Happy!
strings.desc: Pink Bean cheers on the whole party with his special brand of adorableness! Boosts Party EXP, Speed, Attack Power, and Magic Attack Power. However, the obtained EXP bonus is halved for any party members on different maps than the caster.\nUnaffected by buff duration increases.

strings.desc: Pink Bean is one of the finest yo-yo-ers of this generation! Watch this burning trick that clobbers enemies multiple times. Unaffected by attack reflection.

strings.name: Pink Pulverizer
strings.desc: Pink Bean's love for all things pink can be... dangerous. This knocks over a pink pillar to deal heavy damage. During cooldown, there's a chance for Mini Beans to come to your aid, and every time they attack it lowers the cooldown on this skill. Unaffected by attack reflection.

strings.name: Pink Shadow
strings.desc: Pink Bean loooves making shadow pictures, and summons a pink shadow which copies its actions after a short delay. It won't copy certain movement skills, and while it will act out summoning and buff skills, they'll have no additional effect.\nPink Bean sometimes will sometimes look back, notice the shadow, and wonder whether shadows can do that.\n* The shadow's attack is unaffected by attack reflection.

strings.name: Pink Warrior
strings.desc: Jealous of a goddess's boon to her followers, Pink Bean came up with a way to temporarily increase the stats of all his party members.\nThis effect stacks with Maple Warrior, Call of Cygnus, Nova Warrior, President's Orders, Anima Warrior, Rhinne's Protection and Hero of El Nath. They say imitation is the highest form of flattery.

strings.name: Go, Pink Beans!
strings.desc: Pink Bean is interested in moving through portals and keeps on opening new ones to random places. Sometimes someone familiar comes out of those portals.\nThere are still many devoted to following Pink Bean. Still as popular as ever.\nGo, Pink Beans! is not affected by attack reflection.

strings.name: Pink Splitter
strings.desc:
Pink Bean has grown interested in Shade's Soul Splitter, and can use it to divide one nearby enemy's soul.
The split soul explodes after 5 sec, and deals damage to nearby enemies.
Cannot be copied by Pink Shadow.
#Souls will not be split for bosses and stationary monsters.
What pink friend should he create this time?
strings.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Split Souls from Pink Splitter explode after 5 sec, deal #x% + #y% per level damage 5 times up to 15 enemies, and award 100% bonus EXP from eliminated enemies during this time.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

strings.name: Magic Show Time
strings.desc: Pink Bean wants to start his own magic show, so he's 'borrowed' some tools from his fellow monsters. Upon defeating an enemy using a direct attack skill or on attacking a boss, you'll receive 1 Magic Tool per attack. You must gather a certain number of Magic Tools in order to use them, however they cannot be gathered while Magic Show Time is active or on cooldown.\nMagic Show Time is not affected by attack reflection and ends when you change maps.
strings.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Consume all magic tools.
Usable once #x Magic Tools have been gathered, and last for #s seconds. While in combat, assaults up to #mobCount enemies near Pink Bean with Magic Tools, hitting  #attackCount times and dealing #q% damage + #z% per level at regular intervals.
Enhanced at levels #y and level #w respectively to increase your attack speed and range.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

strings.name: Triple Color Spotlight
strings.desc: Everyone listen to my music! There are three different colored spotlights for Superstar Pink Bean shining bright. Since the spotlights are set up only for Pink Bean, enemies under the spotlight take damage. On the other hand, Pink Bean is protected by the power of the spotlights and stats are enhanced. Unaffected by attack reflection.
strings.h:
Install 3 spotlights that shine on you for #time sec. Each spotlight deals #damage% + #s2% per level damage #attackCount times against up to #mobCount enemies within its area.
While you are within the spotlight, you gain Status Resistance +#w, Critical Rate +#v%, and Final Damage +#s%
You receive a separate bonus for each spotlight, up to 3 buffs. The stacked buffs are calculated cumulatively.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

Annoyed from constantly being attacked, Yeti accumulates rage. Upon use, Yeti becomes#c Enraged#.
While Enraged, the skill #cYeti Smash# replaces Snack Dash.
While Enraged, the duration of Hey Pepe!, Yeti Master Chef, and Hero of El Nath will not decrease, but some skills will be unavailable for use.
Yeti Rage is not affected by cooldown resets or buff duration increases.

Lets loose the power of the heavens, as the perfect fusion of your inner strength with Saya's bequeathed power grants your sword the might of the Azure Dragon.

#cLv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%#
strings.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Invincible during casting
The Azure Dragon's power releases #dummyStr shockwaves, dealing #damage% damage to up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times.
Your imbued sword cleaves the world, unleashing #dummyStr5 strikes that deal #dummyStr3% damage to up to #dummyStr2 enemies #dummyStr4 times.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Falling Flower
strings.desc:
A single flower falls, only to raise a wind that shakes the world, sending your sword dancing along the weathered path of your heart.
Use the skill again while the sword wind blows to unleash the #cClimbing Serpent# technique.

#cLv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%#
strings.h:
MP Cost: #dummyStr, Invincible during casting, creates a sword wind that blows for #time sec.
The sword wind deals #damage% damage to up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times.
Attacks a single enemy up to #y times. After hitting a boss #u times, the sword wind disappears. If Climbing Serpent is used on an enemy that has not yet been hit by the maximum number of attacks, it will deal additional attacks equal to the remaining amount.
Ignore Defense: +#dummyStr11%, Boss Damage: +#dummyStr12%, Critical Rate: #dummyStr13%

strings.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Climbing Serpent
strings.desc:
Saya and Ren's combined hearts rise as a serpent triumphant, breaking through the very heavens.
Use the skill again within a certain period of time to unleash the #cSoaring Dragon# technique.

#cLv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%#
strings.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Invincible and ignore status effect while casting Climbing Serpent\nThe climbing serpent releases #dummyStr divine waves, dealing #damage% damage to up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times\nIgnore Defense: +#dummyStr11%, Boss Damage: +#dummyStr12%, Critical Rate: #dummyStr13%

strings.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Soaring Dragon
strings.desc:
Your sword flies like soaring dragon, crushing the wicked beneath the reign of the Azure Dragon.

#cLv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%#
strings.h: MP Cost #mpCon, Invincible and ignore status effect while casting Soaring Dragon\nUnleashes #dummyStr sword strikes, dealing #damage% damage to up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times\nIgnore Defense: +#dummyStr11%, Boss Damage: +#dummyStr12%, Critical Rate: #dummyStr13%

strings.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Falling Flower
Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse
strings.desc:
No flower blooms without someday falling...and once it has, no power can make it blossom again, even though the heavens shake. Take up your sword, Wanderer--for whether you wield it in hope or in grief, the world sorely needs a dragon.

#cLv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%#

Using the skill again within #u sec. unleashes the next technique in your Heartbound Verse
Upon use, unleashes the #cFalling Flower, Climbing Serpent, and Soaring Dragon# techniques in order.
For each technique, Ignore Defense: +#dummyStr11%, Boss Damage: +#dummyStr12%, Critical Rate: #cr%

strings.name: Manifestation: Where the River Courses
strings.desc: #cManifestation Skill#\nManifest the power of the river within a Dragon Vein to allow travel along the river's flow. Reuse the skill within a certain period of time to designate the river's end point. After designating an end point, the river will flow continuously between the start and end point, and Lara can press the Up Arrow key at the start point or end point to ride along the river. The end point cannot be designated at portal locations and certain other areas, and this skill #ccannot be used in some non-hunting maps.# Applies 100% Knockback Resistance during casting. Riding the river allows you to use a skill that finds Dragon Veins 1 time (excluding Manifestation: Where the River Courses), increases the usable range, and also allows you to use skills that find dragon veins in proportion to the distance traveled.

strings.name: Divine Echo
strings.desc: Grants an echo of your battle prowess to a nearby party member, such that they will mirror some of your attack skills and buff skills. If a party member approaches you while your echo is inactive, that party member receives your echo. When the party member moves beyond a certain distance from you, or when Divine Echo is deactivated, the echo is lost. strings.name: Abyssal Lightning
strings.desc: Immerse your surroundings in dark magic and call upon netherworld lightning. When Dark Shock is activated, or an attack caused by Dark Brand is activated, netherworld lightning attacks the area.\nCreates a netherworld passage around the Battle Mage periodically. Pressing a directional button will teleport you to the nearest passage in that direction, then close that passage. strings.name: Salamander Mischief
strings.desc:
Summon the fire of a playful salamander spirit.
Salamander tracks a nearby enemy to attack when a direct skill attack by Blaze Wizard hits. In a single action, it either consumes all of the number of attacks or returns to the summoner's location when it strays too far.
Obtain Ember every time Salamander's attack hits, and Salamander's attack becomes stronger in proportion. You can get a Magic ATT increase buff in return for the Ember when Salamander disappears.
Unaffected by attack reflection, and prioritizes boss with highest Max HP. It's a fire-attribute attack.

MP Cost: #mpCon, Salamander Summon Duration: #time sec, Damage: #damage%, Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount. In a single action, consumes #v MP and attacks by bouncing up to #u times.

Cooldown: #cooltime sec

strings.name: Salamander Mischief
strings.desc: Salamander's Gift increases Magic ATT.

strings.name: Jupiter Thunder
strings.desc: Launch orbs full of the thunder god's power directly at your enemies.\nThe orb goes inside the enemy it touched to deal continuous shock damage. An electric current flows periodically around that enemy to attack others. If the enemy touched by the orb dies or disappears, another one appears in the location of the enemy and moves.\nThe orb disappears if it consumes all of the max number of shocks or moves beyond a certain distance. Unaffected by attack reflection.
strings.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Enemies touched by the orb are stunned #attackCount times, for #damage% damage, at fixed intervals. Max Number of Shocks: #x. Reduces Freeze stacks for every #v stuns.

strings.name: Spiral of Mana
strings.desc:
Utilize the Mana Burst's pentacle to allow clusters of mana to swirl with the speed of a tornado on their own.

With Action Customization enabled, you can use Mana Burst again with the down arrow key.

strings.name: Crystal Gate
strings.desc: Use advanced crystal technology to create passages you can move through freely. When you press the Up Arrow key to activate a Crystal Gate, you can move to the #cnext Crystal Gate in the order they were created#. If you #cuse the last Crystal Gate that was created, you will move back to the first Crystal Gate#.\nThe gates must be recharged after each use, and the gates that you activated will take longer to recharge. You can receive enhancement and attack support during the Crystal Gate duration, and gates can be set up in the air.\nMoving through the passage between gates counts toward necessary distances to activate the flow of combat.

strings.name: Poison Chain
strings.desc: Unleash a fatal poison on a chain of enemies. Poisoned enemies periodically release clouds of additional poison, damaging both themselves and other nearby enemies. Even if they survive the initial explosion, the poison effect stacks, raising the power of further explosions. If an enemy dies or disappears before an explosion, the poison spreads to nearby enemies immediately. If there are no enemies, the effect remains as a crystal for a certain amount of time, ready to spread to nearby enemies and then disappear. Once a certain number of explosions has occurred, the poison will wear off from every enemy simultaneously. Doesn't activate Elemental Drain, and poison is unaffected by attack reflection.

MP Cost: #mpCon, Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Poison Duration: #y sec. Explosions from poisoned enemies attack #v times with #q% damage periodically, and spread to #x enemies nearby that aren't poisoned.

Explosions can occur up to #w times on 1 enemy and up to #u times on all enemies in total.

strings.name: Liberation Orb
strings.desc: Manifest orbs of both light and darkness. Orb attacks target the enemy with the highest max HP first.\nAttacks from the orb are not affected by the effects of Sunfire, Eclipse, or Equilibrium. Unaffected by attack reflection.

strings.desc: Calls forth quirky Mountain Spirits who love to run. They'll then run amok throughout the area, attacking everything they bump into. strings.desc:
Borrows nature's might to awaken the potential of the current #cFocal Target#.
The effects of Awaken do not stack with the Bishop skill 'Benediction.' Awaken's effects are always prioritized.

If used on the #cFocal Target#, rather than yourself, you gain the Resonant effect.

strings.name: Beak Strike
strings.desc: Calls forth Penni's full potential to greatly enhance Peck. For the duration of the skill, Peck becomes Beak Strike, causing it to become AoE and deal significantly more damage. Unaffected by attack reflection.

MP Cost: #mpCon. Immediately restores #w% of Max HP to all party members, grants you the #c[Excess Healing]# effect for #time sec

This is a fire attack.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.

After a short delay, those strikes hit enemies near the Cannoneer, prioritizing boss monsters, enemies with the highest HP, and enemies that have survived previous strikes, in that order. Supplies will drop to support you and your party members during the first bombardment.\nIf there are no platforms for the strikes to fall onto, or if you're hanging on a rope or ladder, supplies will not drop. If the cooldown is reset while there are still strikes in reserve, the skill will end.\nStrikes are unaffected by attack reflection. To pick up the supplies, go near them and press the Up arrow key.

strings.name: Divine Echo
strings.desc: Grants an echo of your battle prowess to a nearby party member, such that they will mirror some of your attack skills and buff skills. If the last party member who received the echo is within range, that party member will receive the echo first. If a party member approaches you while your echo is inactive, that party member receives your echo. When the party member moves beyond a certain distance from you, or when Divine Echo is deactivated, the echo is lost. At that time, any Paladin's buffs applied to that party member will also be removed. This skill cannot be used on a party member who is already echoing the skills of another Paladin. If you use the skill again while skill is active, you can select which party member will receive your echo by pressing the corresponding number key (with regard to the party UI). You cannot select yourself, a party member who is already echoing someone, or a party member who cannot receive an echo.
strings.h: MP Cost: MP #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Final Damage: +#u%\n#cEchoing Party Member# - Upon using an offensive skill, the affected party member mimics you for #x% of Final Damage. Buff Duration on Party Member: #y% + 1% for every #w Strength (up to 100%)\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Divine Echo
strings.desc: Grants an echo of your battle prowess to a party member. It cannot be used on a party member who is already echoing the skills of another Paladin.

strings.name: Benediction
strings.desc: Calls upon your holy power to create a consecrated space that empowers and revitalizes your allies. Benedictions do not stack.
strings.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Final Damage: +#w% in the zone
Party members other than yourself periodically recover #x% of max HP/MP, clear certain statuses, and have their Attack Speed increased.
Party Member Final Damage: +1% per #q2 INT, based on the number of party members (min: #q%, max: #w%).
HP/MP Recovery: +1% per #y INT (up to #z% max)
Attack Speed: +1 per #u INT (up to +3 max)
This increase doesn't count INT granted by Special Skill Rings.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Shadow Slide
strings.desc: Summons an immovable shadow.\nVanishes when its duration ends.\nActivate the skill again to swap places with the shadow or use it with the down arrow key to re-summon the shadow to your current location. A separate cooldown is applied when the shadow is re-summoned.

strings.name: Shield of Light
strings.desc: Temporarily blocks the damage and debilitating status conditions on party members inside the area as you become a shield for your fellow party members, increasing your Final Damage at the same time.

strings.name: Ring of Restraint
strings.desc: Creates a zone in which your Attack Power and Magic Attack are increased. This zone is not destroyed when you move outside it, but the Attack Power and Magic Attack increase effects are only applied while you stay within it.\nNot affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec, Attack Power: +#indiePadR%, Magic ATT: +#indieMadR%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

strings.name: Ultimatum Ring
strings.desc: Fixes the player's Max Damage Range at 2,000,000 temporarily. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., The player's Max Damage Range is fixed at #x.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Limit Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily fixes max MP at 500 to increase damage against Boss Monsters. Not affected by cooldown reset, and cannot be used by classes that do not use MP.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Fixed Max MP: #x MP, Boss Damage: +#indieBDR%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Health Cut Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily decreases max HP to increase damage against Boss Monsters. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Max HP: -#x%, Boss Damage: +#indieBDR%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Mana Cut Ring
strings.desc: Decreases the max MP and ignores a certain percentage of the Defense Rate temporarily. Not affected by cooldown reset, and cannot be used by classes that do not use MP.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Max MP: -#x%, Ignore Defense: +#indieIgnoreMobpdpR%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Durability Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases Max HP. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Max HP: +#indieMhpR%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Critical Damage Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases Critical Damage. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Critical Damage: +#x%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Critical Defense Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily nullifies enemy's Defense Rate by a percentage of your Critical Rate. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Ignored Defense increases by #x% of your Critical Rate.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Critical Shift Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily replaces the value of your Critical Rate with the value of the main stat that you invested all of your AP into. This skill may lower your Critical Rate, and is not affected by cooldown reset effects.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., changes your Critical Rate value to #x% of your main stat.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Stance Shift Ring
strings.desc: A portion of the main stat value that you invested your AP into temporarily becomes the value of your Knockback Resistance. This skill may lower your Knockback Resistance, and is not affected by cooldown reset effects.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., changes your Knockback Resistance to #x% of your main stat.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Totalling Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases your main stats by the sum of all stats. For Xenon, increases the highest stat out of STR, DEX, and LUK. If stats are all the same, increases LUK. For Demon Avenger, increases HP by applying multiplier to that value. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec. Increases your main stat by #t2% of the sum of all your stats.\nIncreases HP of Demon Avenger by #t times this value.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Level Jump S Ring
strings.desc: Increases STR by the character's current level temporarily. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec. Increases STR by #x% of your current character level. Increases HP of Demon Avenger by #t times this value\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Level Jump D Ring
strings.desc: Increases DEX by the character's current level temporarily. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec, Increases DEX by #x% of your current character level\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Level Jump I Ring
strings.desc: Increases INT by the character's current level temporarily. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec, Increases INT by #x% of your current character level\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Level Jump L Ring
strings.desc: Increases LUK by the character's current level temporarily. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec, Increases LUK by #x% of your current character level\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Weapon Jump S Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases STR by a portion of your main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec. Increases STR by #x% of your equipped main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT. Increases HP of Demon Avenger by #t times this value.\n(Apply the higher value between the main weapon's Attack Power and Magic ATT.)\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Weapon Jump D Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases DEX by a portion of your main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec. Increases DEX by #x% of your equipped main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT.\n(Apply the higher value between the main weapon's Attack Power and Magic ATT.)\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Weapon Jump I Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases INT by a portion of your main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec. Increases INT by #x% of your equipped main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT.\n(Apply the higher value between the main weapon's Attack Power and Magic ATT.)\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Weapon Jump L Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases LUK by a portion of your main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec. Increases LUK by #x% of your equipped main weapon's Attack Power or Magic ATT.\n(Apply the higher value between the main weapon's Attack Power and Magic ATT.)\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Swift Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases attack speed. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., increases Attack Speed by #indieBooster.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Overdrive Ring
strings.desc: Allows you to temporarily deal damage to enemies even when they are under Attack Ignore and attack reflection. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., ignores enemy attack ignore and attack reflection effects to deal 100% damage.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Berserker Ring
strings.desc: Ignores a percentage of enemy Defense Rate, but also decreases your Defense temporarily during attacks. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Ignore Defense: +#indieIgnoreMobpdpR%, Defense: -#s%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Reflective Ring
strings.desc: Amplifies incoming damage by a certain amount and reflects it for a limited period of time. Not affected by cooldown reset.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Amplifies incoming damage by #x% and reflects it.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Cleansing Ring
strings.desc: Has a chance to cancel all Abnormal Statuses.\nNot affected by cooldown reset effects.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Grants a #prop% chance to cancel all Abnormal Statuses and be immune to Abnormal Statuses for 3 sec. after use. Does nothing when no Abnormal Statuses are active.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

strings.name: Risk Taker Ring
strings.desc: Temporarily increases Attack Power and Magic Attack. Effect ends when hit by an attack, except for attack reflection. Not affected by cooldown reset effects.
strings.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec., Attack Power: +#indiePadR%, Magic Attack: +#indieMadR%, Ends when hit\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

4th Time: Recovers 2.5% of HP and MP per sec up to 2,500.
5th Time: Recovers 3% of HP and MP per sec up to 3,000.

and then follow up with 7 attacks which deal #q% damage.

strings.name: Human Cannonball Attraction
strings.desc:
Blast your way to new enhancement material items with Spiegelmann's special #c<Human Cannonball Attraction>#!
You'll gain special items based on the region you're playing in, such as Maple World, Arcane River, and Grandis (after Cernium), with even more items available at higher designer ranks.
You can fire off the #c<Human Cannonball Attraction>#, #cby using the skill key directly#, up to 30 times a day. When the date changes, your count will reset.

#cRight-click to turn ON/OFF#
strings.h: Obtain various enhancement material items based on your designer rank and region.\n\n#cObtain 5 Troupe Points every time you defeat monsters#

strings.name: Stage 1 Festival Cannon
strings.desc: Spiegelmann prepared this magical #cStage 1 Festival Cannon# for beginner designers.\nCollect #cmagic bullet materials# by defeating enemies, then #cfire the cannon by using the skill key directly#.\nSince this cannon is a rough prototype, it'll fire #cSloppy Confetti Pieces#.
strings.h: Activate this skill to fire #cSloppy Confetti Pieces#. Acquire those pieces to obtain various enhancement material items, based on your designer rank and region.\n#cCooldown: #cooltimeMS sec#.

strings.name: Stage 2 Festival Cannon
strings.desc: Spiegelmann prepared this magical #cStage 2 Festival Cannon# for junior designers.\nCollect #cmagic bullet materials# by defeating enemies, then #cfire the cannon by using the skill key directly#.\nSince this cannon is somewhat enhanced, it'll fire #cNormal Confetti Pieces#.
strings.h: Activate this skill to fire #cNormal Confetti Pieces#. Acquire those pieces to obtain various enhancement material items, based on your designer rank and region.\n#cCooldown: #cooltimeMS sec#.

strings.name: Stage 3 Festival Cannon
strings.desc: Spiegelmann prepared this magical #cStage 3 Festival Cannon# for senior designers.\nCollect #cmagic bullet materials# by defeating enemies, then #cfire the cannon by using the skill key directly#.\nSince this cannon is enhanced, it'll fire #cFancy Confetti Pieces#.
strings.h: Activate this skill to fire #cFancy Confetti Pieces#. Acquire those pieces to obtain various enhancement material items, based on your designer rank and region.\n#cCooldown: #cooltimeMS sec#.

strings.name: Stage 4 Festival Cannon
strings.desc: Spiegelmann prepared this magical #cStage 4 Festival Cannon# for veteran and master designers.\nCollect #cmagic bullet materials# by defeating enemies, then #cfire the cannon by using the skill key directly#.\nSince this cannon is greatly enhanced, it'll fire #cSpecial Confetti Pieces#.
strings.h: Activate this skill to fire #cFancy Confetti Pieces#. Acquire those pieces to obtain various enhancement material items, based on your designer rank and region.\n#cCooldown: #cooltimeMS sec#.
